text:
The latest release for a project named "Filament" depends on which project is being referred to, as there are at least two distinct and actively developed software projects sharing this name [1][2].

The most recent published release across all identified projects is **Google Filament v1.77.2**, which was released on **October 6, 2026** [2]. This version of the real-time physically based rendering engine is available as a Maven dependency for Android and via CocoaPods for iOS [2].

For the **Filament PHP framework**, which is used for building Laravel applications and admin panels, the latest stable release is **v5.9.0**, published on **September 26, 2026** [3]. The Filament PHP framework saw its v5 release in January 2026, with no further major versions planned for 2026. Instead, development is focusing on improving versions 5 and 4, and scaling content production [4]. Recent updates, such as v5.9.0, include new features like strict hierarchical breadcrumbs and Rich Editor enhancements [5].

sources.title: Releases · filamentphp/filament · GitHub
claims: The release notes for Filament v3.3.56 include a fix for using valid Livewire upload references in restriction tests and using file hash names for uploaded files.

The release notes for Filament v5.9.0 include new features such as strict hierarchical breadcrumbs, Rich Editor enhancements (icons, grid layout, search, sticky controls, minimal custom controls), search for Builder block picker, customizable table filters reset action, resolving nested resource index URLs, enum() for ImportColumn, nested action parent data, button size helper for ToggleButtons, full-width toggle buttons, rich content faker, Markdown faker, opt-in CSP nonce support for scripts, and table content render hooks.

The release notes for Filament v4.14.0 include new features such as strict hierarchical breadcrumbs, Rich Editor enhancements (icons, grid layout, search, sticky controls, minimal custom controls), search for Builder block picker, customizable table filters reset action, resolving nested resource index URLs, enum() for ImportColumn, nested action parent data, button size helper for ToggleButtons, full-width toggle buttons, rich content faker, Markdown faker, and table content render hooks.
The release notes for Filament v5.8.4 include a fix for collapsing non-contained sections correctly.

The release notes for Filament v5.8.3 include Swedish and Estonian translations, fixes for Livewire's DataStore singleton binding, FileUpload audio preview interactions, query builder filter indicators, Dropdown aria-controls loop, password checks for MFA actions, mobile-stacked table layouts, state casts from cached child schemas, temporary test paths, and rendering column orders.
The release notes for Filament v4.13.4 include a fix for collapsing non-contained sections correctly.

The release notes for Filament v4.13.3 include Swedish and Estonian translations, fixes for Livewire's DataStore singleton binding, FileUpload audio preview interactions, query builder filter indicators, Dropdown aria-controls loop, password checks for MFA actions, mobile-stacked table layouts, state casts from cached child schemas, temporary test paths, and rendering column orders.

The release notes for Filament v5.8.2 include German, pt-BR, and Czech translations, documentation updates for app authentication cache requirements and shared Blueprint workflow, fixes for mobile-stacked tables, page header content squeezing, rich editor content area clickability, session persistence for TableSelect, and rebuilding repeatable entry items.

The release notes for Filament v4.13.2 include German, pt-BR, and Czech translations, documentation updates for app authentication cache requirements and shared Blueprint workflow, fixes for mobile-stacked tables, page header content squeezing, rich editor content area clickability, session persistence for TableSelect, and rebuilding repeatable entry items.
The release notes for Filament v5.8.1 include fixes for scrollbar-gutter-stable utility, enum state casts, and FileUpload's visibilitychange.
